manifest.name: q4k-qkv-attn-mlp-nvfp4-blockfit-zo-lmhead
manifest.description: A low-memory map: Q4_K on the recurrent qkv projection of layers 1-63, on every attention projection and on MLP layers 1-63, with nvfp4_blockfit bytes on the recurrent z and out projections and on layer 0, and lm_head fitted once as Q4_K. Q4_K stores 4.5 bits per weight where NVFP4 keeps 5.0 resident, so peak memory falls about 1.4 GiB below V0 while decode stays near it. Unlike the earlier Q4_K maps this low in memory, z and out keep blockfit bytes and attention moves to Q4_K; measured by section, long-context drift is 0.34 of V0's and multilingual 0.72. Layer 0 keeps NVFP4 bytes, which select the batched-prefill path; the cost of the map is 4K prefill.
